reason: Unified memory index slice S3 (design/unified-memory/60-build-step-3.md): the analytics process projects the current Rollup build's outings, stays and trips into the memory index, keyed by their citation so a memo's citation reaches the same happening across a rebuild; a build switch moves the episodes in its own transaction, a build still building has none, and the delete half of the outing diff drops them. Outings carry their unit and every person in them, stays and trips their person alone, both with their presence lineage; no node text holds a place, a coordinate or a person. Messages written during an outing get `during` edges, and each analytics run drains the projection queue. It is dark: written, read by nothing until S5, so no user-visible behaviour changes.
